				17 text ABOUT THIS PROJECT
				18 heading About and privacy, Value: 1
					19 text About and privacy
				20 text A free, independent, open-source Hound Foundry community project for adults affected by vertebral or carotid artery dissection, families, carers and interested readers.
				21 heading What this project is, Value: 2
					22 text What this project is
				23 text This is an early development preview, not a charity, healthcare provider or medical service. It does not diagnose, interpret scans, recommend medication, estimate individual risk, clear activity or replace a clinician. Personal questions about diagnosis, tests and treatment belong with the person’s own care team.
				24 heading Clinical and lived-experience review, Value: 2
					25 text Clinical and lived-experience review
				26 text All guides are original drafts with linked sources and recorded review fields. No clinician or patient/carer usability review has yet been recorded. The app must not publish these guides as approved patient information until qualified review is documented.
				27 text The user-suggested 2017 book is listed bibliographically as an external reading resource. Its chapters and stories are not reproduced or translated.
				28 heading Privacy and open source, Value: 2
					29 text Privacy and open source
				30 text No account, analytics, advertising, sync service or backend is part of V1. Appointment sheets are stored on your device only when you choose Save. Web storage uses your browser profile’s local storage; native storage uses Expo SecureStore. Each has different device and backup behavior, so neither guarantees privacy. See the repository privacy documentation before storing sensitive notes.
				31 text The source code uses the project’s existing open-source licence, and authored guide content uses its existing content licence. The app is free to use; it has no donation, advertising or story-submission feature.
				32 link Read the privacy design notes ↗

				38 text Use this when you want to remove all appointment questions, support preferences, personal cards, milestone cards, accessibility preferences and saved guide links from this device. It does not remove exported files or backups made outside this app.

					51 text Use it like an app
				52 text On browsers that support installation, use the browser menu’s “Install” or “Add to home screen” action. The web version remains a static information tool: it does not create an account, add a server connection or change where saved sheets live.
